title: Self JOIN
description: Find pairs of employees who work in the same department. Show each pair once (e.g. 'Alice Johnson' and 'Bob Smith' but not the reverse). Exclude pairing an employee with themself. Return columns: employee_1, employee_2, department.
hints: Join the employees table to itself
Condition: e1.department = e2.department AND e1.employee_id < e2.employee_id
